limitations: Windows transport runs are small diagnostic fixtures, not native Linux mixed-BT acceptance.
Repeated fresh-process transport diagnostics and the separate 30-minute empty-session RPC process do not establish multi-hour active-transfer stability.
Five-second host samples do not attribute the retained 100250us changeUri failure.
WSL1 uses the existing libnanosleep system preload; no native Linux timing or io_uring acceptance.
Native-only TSan does not instrument the Rust standard library and test harness.
The protocol inventory includes one standalone crash-child helper that returns without work; exclude it from behavioral coverage.
Full/compat artifacts retain absolute native-dependency paths and additional runtime requirements; no package or release approval.
Fresh/minimum OS, macOS/MSVC, hardware power loss and final release matrix remain open.
